titleEn: I Want to Ring It Now

pages.text: A tall bell tower stood in the village center. The bell rang on festival morning.
This year, Rudi would ring it. The four watched with envious faces.
"When do I ring it?" "When the sun is above the roofs."
Rudi waited, holding the bell rope. The sun was still below the roofs, and their hands were itching to pull.
Rudi pulled the rope. Dong! Dong!
The four were first to rush out. But nothing in the square was ready.
Rudi let go of the rope. The square grew quiet again.
Beside Rudi, Grandma Bear looked at the roofs. "Rudi, where is the sun now?"
The sun rose above the roofs. Rudi pulled the rope.
Dong! Dong! Dong! The four ran over, waving. The square filled with people.
